full_prompt_en: A square, finely stippled storybook illustration shows a densely stacked city at night beneath a nearly black sky. Hundreds of small cream and warm ocher buildings climb both sides of a central gap, with pointed towers, domes, pitched roofs, and countless square windows. The buildings form two uneven hills of masonry, leaving an open black channel through the upper center. Small white circles and dots float in the sky like stylized moons or stars. A tiny silver flying-saucer shape hovers just left of center above the rooftops. At the bottom, a pale winding road leads from the foreground toward a dark arched gate in a stone wall. Several miniature black pedestrians walk along the road and beneath the trees. Two rows of rounded copper-brown trees frame the lower city, their dense leaflike texture drawn with thousands of short marks. The ground and foreground slopes are almost black, making the pale road and trees stand out. The upper edge of the sky fades into a band of delicate white stippling, like grain or a glowing cloud layer. There is little realistic directional light; warm windows and pale stone surfaces appear evenly luminous against the dark sky. Fine pen lines and stippled dots cover the architecture, foliage, and celestial accents. The composition is symmetrical in broad mass but varied in individual rooftops, giving the image a measured, intricate rhythm. The flying saucer adds a quiet absurd note to the otherwise old-world cityscape.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细点描绘本插画呈现密密叠起的夜城，上方是近黑天空。数百座奶油色与暖赭色小房屋沿中央空隙两侧攀升，带尖塔、圆顶、斜屋顶和数不清的方窗。建筑形成两座不齐的砌墙山，在上部中央留下黑色通道。小白圆和点浮在天空，像程式化的月或星。一个极小银色飞碟形悬在中央稍左的屋顶上方。下方，一条浅色弯路从前景通向石墙上的深拱门。几个微小黑人影沿路、在树下行走。两排圆润铜褐色树夹住城市下部，浓密叶状纹理由数千道短笔痕绘成。地面与前景坡近乎全黑，使浅路与树突出。天空上缘淡入一条细白点描带，像颗粒或发光云层。几乎没有现实定向光；暖窗和浅石面在黑天空前均匀发亮。细钢笔线和点描覆盖建筑、枝叶及天体重音。构图在总体色团上对称，但个别屋顶多变，让图像节奏有序而繁密。飞碟给原本古旧的城市景观加上一点安静荒诞。
style_prompt_en: A finely inked storybook image uses a near-black ground against cream, ocher, and muted copper forms. Hundreds of tiny rectangular marks and slender pointed accents stack densely at the sides, leaving a dark open channel through the upper center. Repeated rounded masses line the lower area, their surfaces built from tight stippling and short grainy strokes. A pale winding line guides the eye toward a small central dark aperture; miniature black accents along it provide scale. Sparse circular marks hover in the otherwise empty black field. Lighting is graphic rather than directional: pale surfaces and warm dots seem to glow by value contrast, with no cast shadows. The surface resembles pen and print, precise but visibly textured. Broad bilateral balance and many small local variations create a calm, intricate rhythm with a touch of whimsy.
style_prompt_zh: 细墨线绘本图像把近黑底面与奶油色、赭色和低饱和铜色形块对照。数百个微小矩形笔形及细尖重音在两侧密集堆起，上部中央留出深暗空道。下部排列重复圆润团块，表面由紧密点描和短颗粒笔触组成。一条浅色弯线把视线引向中央小暗孔，沿线微黑重音提供尺度。稀疏圆点悬在其余空黑色域。照明是图形性的，而非定向；浅色表面和暖色点靠明度反差似在发亮，没有投影。表面像钢笔与印刷，精确却明显有肌理。两侧总体平衡加上许多局部小变化，形成平静繁密、略带奇想的节奏。
theme_en: A dense storybook city beneath a black sky with a small flying saucer
theme_zh: 黑夜里有小飞碟的密集绘本城市
name: Tom Gauld
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
